query.normalizedText:
SELECT *
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE c.country = $1
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
LIMIT $2

findings.title: Sequential scan with an unindexed filter
findings.evidence: Seq Scan on customers filters country (est. 2857 of ~20000 rows, total cost 473.00).

findings.title: Unindexed join key
findings.evidence: Join on orders.customer_id has no index, so the orders side is scanned (~200000 rows).

findings.title: Sort feeding a Limit (top-N could use an ordered index)
findings.evidence: Top-N sorts orders by created_at (sort node cost 4686.59); an index in that order avoids the sort.

validation.label: Suppressed: hypothetical index used but cost fell only 2.7% (< 15% threshold).
